title: General compatibility
patterns: will it work on my computer
does it work on desktops and laptops
what do i need to run it
response: It runs on Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit) on desktops and laptops, including older machines still on Windows 7. The toolkit itself runs from your USB drive, so it does not need to be installed on any PC.
followup: Do you want to know about driver coverage?

title: Brands supported
patterns: does it work on any brand
response: Any brand: Dell, HP, Lenovo, Acer, Asus, MSI, Samsung, Toshiba and custom-built desktops. Driver detection is hardware-based, not brand-based, so it also handles generic and whitebox machines.
followup: Do you want the detail on the offline driver pack?

title: Which drivers are covered
response: The offline pack covers motherboard and chipset, LAN, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, audio, video and the usual peripheral components. For very new or exotic hardware that shipped after the pack was built, the updater lets you pull the freshest installer from the panel.
